# /mb-garden

Find stale links, indexes, contradictory records and obsolete project guidance.
Apply `.memory-bank/workflows/execute-loop.md#working-policy`: consult the operator on substantive choices unless autonomy was explicitly granted; carry out settled decisions without repeated approval.

Use the existing Memory Bank routers and installed skill inventory to scope the
inspection. Mechanical fixes with one evidenced interpretation can be applied
under the maintenance request. Consult on semantic choices, archival, deletion
or merging unless the granted autonomy covers them. Do not turn every TODO
into a requirement or task.

Preserve user-authored knowledge and task history. Framework-owned scripts,
workflow references and templates are updated through the external installer;
filled project protocols remain project-owned.

Validate the links and records changed. Use lint or doctor when their checks
help diagnose the affected state, not as mandatory admission gates. Reconcile
related Memory Bank records directly when the decision is settled; `/mb-sync`
is an optional focused aid. Return changed files, checks and unresolved issues.
